city.area: The area refers to the size of the city measured in square kilometers (for instance, 89.64).
player.draft_pick: The selection order in which the player was chosen during the NBA draft (e.g., 1).
player.college: the university where the player studied, provided they went to one, for instance, Duke University.
player.fiba_world_cup: The count of FIBA World Cup championships the player has secured (e.g., 1).
player.draft_year: the year the player was chosen in the NBA draft; formatted as YYYY (e.g., 2003).
player.nba_championships: The quantity of NBA championships the player has achieved (e.g., 4).
team.ownership: ownership refers to the individual who owns the team (e.g., Jeanie Buss).
